texts.orig: To consider the impact on the incomes of all older people we present the average effects on those 65 Or over; because of the assumed age limits; there will, by definition, be no effect on the incomes of those under 70 except where are married to someone considerably older than themselves. We therefore also present results for those 70 or over. In addition; we show the effect of equity release on those at least 75, since in general it is among this oldest age-group that incomes are lowest (see, for example, Department of Social Security (1997)). aged aged they aged aged
